title: A Canon of the Rising Squall
summary: A canon on lifting wind and rain qi from the legs in one swelling squall that carries a blow or a guard.

title: A Treatise on Lashing Rain
summary: A treatise on whipping slanted rain qi across the opponent and turning the same sheets into a guard.

title: The Thunderclap Drill-Book
summary: A drill-book of sudden loud strikes that clap storm qi against the target and leave the ears ringing.

title: Handbook of the Funnel Cloud
summary: A handbook on drawing storm qi into a narrow turning funnel that sucks in and lifts and throws what it touches.

title: The Sleet and Hail Course
summary: A course in the cold side of the storm where qi freezes into driven sleet and hard stones of hail.

title: A Canon of the Breaking Storm
summary: A canon of how a storm builds its force slowly and breaks it all at once on the one target.

title: The Tempest Compendium
summary: A compendium of wind and rain and thunder moves that a student is taught to join into the first real tempest.
